response.guide: results is positional — aligned one-to-one with the requested symbols, in order. A null entry means that symbol could not be resolved (invalid, delisted, or non-equity) or has no reported financials available; surface it as "no data for X" rather than dropping it silently. Within an entry, financials is most-recent-first. Tell quarterly from annual rows by fiscal_quarter (null for annual). Present null metric values as "not available", not zero. net_margin is already a percentage — do not multiply by 100.
